instruct:
A male voice. Accent: Nebraska farm boy, slow and friendly. Wilbur, the boy who works the counter at Dobbs Feed and Seed in Wahoo.
Natural, conversational telephone speech, 1950s.
sample_text: Dobbs Feed and Seed, this is Wilbur. We got the laying mash in, and the chicken wire, and I think that's about all we got.
